compare_blocks.body:
Taking gentle and puts people first as belonging to INFP is the common mismatch in this pair. ENTP also adjusts wording when particular people are affected, and also asks about the background before pointing at a problem; gentleness is a communication habit with no one-to-one mapping onto four letters.

Reading picks at logic and loves arguing as a Thinking marker is no more accurate. Both share N and P and both will turn a problem over and over; the difference is the standard used in judging — whether the inference and the rule hold and apply alike, or what this means for particular people. Whether someone enjoys an argument depends more on how well they know the subject and whether the setting allows it.

A person who weighs personal values may still base a decision on detailed observations. A person who emphasises logical consistency may start with an untested idea. Ask what evidence and criteria support the decision.

The fourth takes E for talkative and sociable. E means attention and energy turn outward more often; either type may say very little in an unfamiliar setting, and either may not stop talking about a subject they know.

The fifth takes who speaks first or who opens the vouchers first as evidence. What gets done first follows role, duty, experience and conditions on the day, and the same person changes approach with the post.
